$comment: One view folder = one lazy bundle (dist/views/<folder>.js). The build registers every type listed here; docs/CONTRACT.md §1. Loading this bundle also defines <data-kpi> and <data-sparkline>. The default export picks the class by the view's type (kpi, gauge, bullet, barlist, status).

views.name: KPI
views.summary: One stat card, or one per group: the value with its unit and basis, a delta coloured by which way is better, an SVG sparkline, "computed from N runs"; the headline card draws its history as a chart.

views.name: Gauge
views.summary: One number against a scale: a rounded progress bar or a semicircle arc, a target tick, colour bands and over / under the target; the value is the producer's or a summary over the rows.

views.name: Bullet
views.summary: One bullet chart per row or group, aligned: grey bands, the value bar, a target tick and the value at the right.

views.name: Bar list
views.summary: A ranked list (Tremor's BarList): one row per label with its value summarised, a bar behind the label, the rest as "+N more".

views.name: Tracker
views.summary: A tracker (Tremor's Tracker): one row per group, one small block per row coloured by its state, a legend of the states present.
